evidence.quote: The Mach number is the ratio of the speed of the aircraft, or the speed of the gas, to the speed of sound in the gas.
where M is the Mach number.
For low speed, or subsonic conditions, the Mach number is less than one, M < 1,
As the speed increases beyond the speed of sound, the flight Mach number is greater than one, M > 1,
